sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
Council (the Principal) is seeking Quotations from appropriately qualified and experienced Contractors to convert an existing ozone/ bromine disinfection system to a chlorine/UV disinfection system at the Moss Vale War Memorial Aquatic Centre in Moss Vale, NSW.
A more detailed brief of the extent of services required by Council is set out in Volume 1 - Specification which is included as part of the Request for Quotation documentation.
In accordance with Council Policy and Guidelines, Council invites quotationsin accordance with this Invitation and the following accompanying documents:
· Volume 1 - Specification
· Volume 2 - Response Schedules
· Volume 3 - Conditions of Contract, and
· Any published Addenda
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content: Please refer to downloadable document Volume 1 - Specification.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
1.
Mandatory - Attendance at the Mandatory Site inspection
Did the Contractor / Contractor’s Representative attend the Mandatory Quotation Briefing/Site Inspection?
Response type
Radio button (Yes/No)
2.
Mandatory - Volume 2 - Response Schedules
This Volume contains Response Schedules to be completed and submitted as part of the Respondent’s proposal and will be used to evaluate the submission in accordance with the established Mandatory Criteria, Non-cost Weighted Criteria and Cost Weighted Criteria.
Response type
File upload (Multiple)
3.
Mandatory - Public Liability Insurance - minimum $20 million
Insurance against the death or injury to any third party or parties or loss of or damage to any property including loss of use of property whether it is damaged or not whatsoever caused during the course of the contract. The policy shall have a limit of indemnity of not less than the amount indicated for any one occurrence.
Response type
File upload (Multiple)
4.
Mandatory - Workers Compensation Insurance
Workers Compensation/ Personal Accident  and Illness   Insurance or Personal Income Protection.
Insurance against any death of or injury to persons employed by the Supplier as required by the Workers Compensation Act 1987 .
In the event of the Contractor being a Sole Trader or Partnership, the Contractor must provide Council with a copy of either a Personal Accident and Illness   Insurance Policy or a Personal Income Protection Policy.
Response type
File upload (Multiple)
5.
Mandatory - Comprehensive Motor Vehicle Insurance
In the case of any motor vehicle used in the performance of any contract, a Comprehensive Motor Vehicle Insurance policy including cover for accidental damage, fire and theft is required.  The policy shall be for a sum not less than the full market value of the vehicle/s.
Response type
File upload (Multiple)
